articles.title: Switch 2-Compatible SanDisk MicroSD Express Cards Are Up to $70 Off for Black Friday
articles.summary: Make room for more games with discounts on 256GB, 512GB, and 1TB cards
articles.body:
All the Black Friday deals are live, including Nintendo’s sale . That means you can pick up a whole bunch of new Switch 2 games on the cheap , though you may need extra storage for some of the more space-hungry titles. Luckily, Samsung discounted MicroSD Express cards for the Switch 2 , and so has SanDisk.

A 256GB SanDisk MicroSD Express card is down to $49.99, or if you need serious room, a 1TB model has dropped to $289.99 from its usual $359.99. There’s also a 512GB SanDisk card under $100 right now. These are some of IGN’s favorite cards to slot into the Switch 2 , thanks to their reliability and speed, making them a worthwhile investment

Save on SanDisk MicroSD Express Cards for Switch 2

While the Switch 2 offers much more storage than the original Switch, its 256GB can still fill up fast. Unfortunately, the Switch 2 doesn't support non-Express MicroSD cards, so you’ll need to splurge on an upgrade if you're just getting into Nintendo's latest console. With read speeds of 880MB/s and write speeds up to 650MB/s or more, these SanDisk Cards are slightly faster than competing options from PNY and Samsung.

How much space you need depends on the games you want to keep accessible at all times, especially as more titles go digital or come as game-key cards. I mean, Final Fantasy 14 alone will eat up close to half the console’s built-in storage. Other titles, like Split Fiction, Kingdom Hearts Collection, and Cyberpunk 2077, also eat up a good chunk of space. For libraries with a lot of titles like those, 1TB might be the way to go. If you tend to go for smaller indie titles or Nintendo's own typically smaller games, you can likely get by with 256GB or 512GB.

articles.title: The Shrek Toaster Is the Only Black Friday Deal You Need
articles.body:
Do you ever throw some bread in the toaster and think to yourself, "Wow, this toast would taste better with Shrek’s face on it?"

Well, Amazon’s Black Friday deals can make your questionable culinary dream a reality. Uncanny Brands produces a line of retro TV-themed toasters that burn images straight onto your bread. For the season of deals, Amazon gave most of these quirky (and, somehow, officially licensed) toasters a 15% discount , bringing them to their lowest-ever prices.

Amazon’s discount knocks around $7 off the price of each toaster in these lightning deals, which will disappear once they’re fully claimed. For whatever reason, that seems to be happening surprisingly fast.

The list of themed toasters is about as weird as the concept itself. We’ve got Shrek , of course, but you can also sear into your bread images of Bluey , Sonic , Snoopy , and, um, Bob Ross ? Uncanny Valley also produces a Grinch toaster , but that one isn't getting a discount. Stingy guy, I guess.

According to the official listing , the two-slot toaster features an adjustable thermostat with defrost, quick stop, and reheat functions. Each toaster is emblazoned with an image, dedicated to whatever weird property it prints on bread, in a light-up frame.

I’m going to be honest, I can’t vouch for the quality of the Shrek toaster myself. I use the cheapest possible toaster option from Amazon and have been pretty satisfied with it. Still, maybe I’m not quite as satisfied as users of the Shrek-ster:

"I love this toaster," says the most-upvoted review . "I like that it lights up when you are making toast." Very insightful, I know.

The most legit-looking reviews note that you have to do a little experimentation to find the right settings for maximum image effect, and sometimes that means straight-up burning the bread. Apparently you might also notice a weird smell the first time you use it. Yum!

We're Keeping Track of Normal Black Friday Deals, Too

We’re in the thick of Black Friday season. For the Shrek-maxxers, you can probably find the movie in Amazon’s DVD and Blu-ray deals , while Dreamworks home Peacock is one of the many services offering a Black Friday streaming discount . Even LEGO Shrek is on sale in the mess of LEGO deals .

If you’re looking for somewhat normal deals, we’ve got you covered there, too. Check out what’s happening at Nintendo , PlayStation , and Xbox , or our full guide to all things Black Friday .

Blythe (she/her) is an Audience Development Coordinator at IGN who spends way too much time in character customization screens and tracking down collectibles.

articles.title: Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair Dev's Explanation for Skipping Xbox Sparks Backlash
articles.summary: Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair: Definitive Edition developer Playtonic has come under fire from Xbox owners after it ruled out an Xbox Series X and S version of the rerelease.
articles.body:
Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair: Definitive Edition developer Playtonic has come under fire from Xbox owners after it ruled out an Xbox Series X and S version of the rerelease.

In a statement published online, the UK studio said it had to prioritize the PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch 2 versions because the cost of bringing it to Xbox "just isn't viable for us at this time." The original game, released in 2018, launched on Xbox One at the same time as PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch. The next-gen upgrade hits PC, PS5, and Switch 2 only on December 15.

"Unfortunately, we've had to prioritize our efforts given the technical challenges and costs presented in the creation of this updated version of the game and as a result, we are unable to commit to any additional platforms for the forseeable future," Playtonic said.

"We understand the frustration felt by those of you who won't be able to access the Definnitive Edition at launch, but unfortunately the cost of bringing it to more platforms just isn't viable for us at this time. As a small team, we hope you guys can understand the challenges we face. Please know that this wasn't an easy decision to make, and we apologize to any of you affected by this.

"We only wish things were different, and we value every single one of you and your feedback."

Playtonic's statement is light on specifics, but most are reading between the lines here and assuming what the studio is saying here is that it weighed up how much it would cost to port the rerelease to Xbox Series X and S against its potential return, and found the numbers didn't add up.

"This means the game didn’t do meaningful numbers on the Xbox. It doesn’t make any sense otherwise," one person suggested . "They could’ve just said the game sold bad on Xbox and they don’t have enough money or time to justify updating it," another said .

Whatever the reason, Xbox fans certainly aren't happy. "Slap in the face to Xbox fans who’ve supported you from the beginning," one Xbox user said . "Will not support you any longer or buy any future Playtonic games if we’re not gonna be treated equally."

"It's a free upgrade for a game we've already brought. The same as the other platforms but you are treating us poorly," another added . "So no we don't understand. No matter how you slice it, it's a **** you to Xbox buyers."

"So... you can't afford to make a FREE upgrade for Xbox... but you could afford it for every other platform?" one person asked . "Well... won't be buying anything of yours from this point on. So there's even less money for you."

"I could buy this game on PS5 or Switch but it’s clear you don’t want or deserve my support," another said.

Rhiannon (she/her) is a freelance journalist who has been in the industry since 2019. She won MCV's Women in Games award in 2025 and adores RPGs. You can follow her on Bluesky at @rhithewitch.

articles.title: The LEGO Transformers Bumblebee Set Hits Its Lowest Price Ever for Black Friday
articles.body:
There are tons of LEGO deals this Black Friday, covering sets new and old. That includes the Transformers Bumblebee build, which is down to $63 from its $90 sticker price, and is scheduled for retirement at the end of the year, meaning LEGO will not produce anymore.

The 950-piece kit is a really cool recreation of the iconic Autobot's cartoon look. It's roughly 9.5 inches tall while standing, and about 8.5in. long and 3in. tall when transformed into vehicle mode. Not only is this a really cool build on its own, but its designed in a way that allows to transform like traditional Transformers toys.

Don't expect it to be exactly the same as a purpose-built action figure, though. IGN's Kevin Wong, who built the set last year , called the Bumblebee LEGO set "fun to play with, fun to build, but a bit challenging to transform."

Other LEGO builds retiring at the end of 2026 are also on sale for Black Friday, so this might be one of the last opportunities to pick a new one up at a lower price. Check them out below.

articles.title: Jenga: Super Mario Edition Is 43% Off for Black Friday
articles.body:
There are so many great Mario games to check out on the Nintendo Switch . If you're like me and you've beaten almost every Mario game out there, the next step is to look to other Mario experiences. ( The Super Mario Galaxy Movie is a fun time, too, for instance.)

One of the best Black Friday deals happens to be Mario-themed, in fact, as the Jenga: Super Mario Edition is on sale for under $13, or 43% off its usual price. This fun Mushroom Kingdom-inspired board game can really shake up your next game night, so don't miss it.

This Super Mario version is like regular Jenga, but with a fun set of Super Mario-themed twists. For one, its blocks are modeled after those in Mario games. It also uses a spinner to determine the number of blocks you need to stack, how many layers you need to jump, and whether or not you can collect coins. Each player chooses a character: Mario, Luigi, Peach, or Toad, and the goal, of course, is to defeat Bowser by racing up the tower. Like any game of Jenga, it's all over if the tower falls, so you have to defeat Bowser before it's too late.

This sale won't last long, and for just over $12, it's hard to beat what could be a great addition to your board game collection .

Noah Hunter is a freelance writer and reviewer covering games and technology. When he's not writing for IGN, he runs Final Weapon, a site focused on Japanese games and anime. His favorite series include Xeno, Fate, Final Fantasy, and far too many RPGs to list.

articles.title: Yooka-Laylee’s free upgrade is skipping Xbox
articles.summary: Playtronic Games says Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair: Definitive Edition won’t come to Xbox because of ‘technological challenges and costs.’
articles.body: Playtronic Games is getting ready to launch Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair: Definitive Edition as a free update on PlayStation 5, Switch 2, and PC on December 15th. Unfortunately for Xbox owners, the developer says it “can’t commit to any additional platforms for the foreseeable future.” In a statement posted on X, Playtronic said that it understands the frustration some players may feel, but that bringing the Definitive Edition to Xbox just isn’t viable “given the technological challenges and costs,” and reminded people that they’re a small team. [Media: Some, like The Game Business editor-in-chief Christopher Dring, have speculated that Xbox’s smaller install base has made it harder for some indie devs to “financially justify” launching on Xbox. Others, like John Linneman of Digital Foundry, have countered that Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair: Definitive Edition is ultimately a minor update and pointed out that the Xbox Series X version was already available in native 4K, unlike the PS4 and Switch versions.

articles.title: The Heart's Trail Walkthrough - Phantom Blade Zero Guide - IGN
articles.summary: The Heart’s Trail is the sixth chapter in Phantom Blade Zero. This chapter begins soon after you leave Myst’s underground tavern. This
articles.body:
The Heart’s Trail is the sixth chapter in Phantom Blade Zero . This chapter begins soon after you leave Myst’s underground tavern. This walkthrough will guide you through the second half of the story content in Pangzhen.

Jump to a specific section of the page using the header links below:

This story quest begins in front of the Backstreet Archway Bell . With Yu’er gone, Soul decides to visit her home, likely located in the backstreets.

Ring the bell and upgrade your equipment – we’re starting off with an early boss fight.

Boss Battle: Wu Xuan, the Fallen General

Walk up the stairs at the Backstreet Archway Bell to find Wu Xuan, the Fallen General , waiting for you in a circular arena. He’s another shielded boss, but you have several ways to deal with that at this point.

Here are the special moves you should know.

Wu Xuan, the Fallen General, is a slow-moving boss who hits hard. This fight is similar to your encounter with Zhuo Bi, the Gatekeeper . Wu Xuan’s body is shielded, and he attacks in a similar fashion.

Wu Xuan ignites his weapon at around 60% HP to greatly increase his offensive power. The slow-moving fireballs can surround you, and he now creates a flaming AoE on the ground at the end of most combos.

If the combo ender isn’t a flash attack, you need to dodge out of the flaming circle on the ground to avoid burning.

You earn the Wolfjaw Phantom Edge (Destructive) for winning the fight. This is another weapon that can drain HP through damage, but it doesn’t work on puppets, Golden Bodies, or Phantom Bodies.

Its Soul Tempering ability allows you to use the purple ghostfire, causing targets to continuously lose HP and Sha-Chi.

There are three paths leading away from the circular boss arena platform. Two are optional. First, look west toward a large building next to a circular doorway. The building contains Remnant Dust and x2 Polished Forged Metal. You can walk through to the back of the house.

There’s x5 Polished Twinned Metal on he other side of the circular doorway, and this path also leads to the back of the house where you’ll find a Traversal Talisman, Polished Broadplate Metal, and a Quick Hand Zhang chest with the Ink Stick treasure inside.

Return to the boss arena and go east this time. Walk through the building with Quick Hand Zhang’s marker (the shining knife) on it to find an upgrade material chest and the Zhang’s Hideout (Pangzhen) Bell .

Speak to Zhang to receive the Lost Treasures of Pangzhen collectible that lists the treasures he’s looking for. This starts the Quick Hand’s Request side quest for this area.

Return to the boss arena one final time. Head north through the lantern-lit gate to the left of the path you took to find Zhang.

Defeat the fire archers and puppets that ambush you on the steps, and continue upward to find the Backstreet Rest Bell .

Defeat all the puppets and Transcensions that appear near the bell to obtain a Blackstone Shard . Then, head east toward the lantern-lit building to find a purple chest full of upgrade materials.

Go back to the bell and climb the stairs nearby. Defeat the puppets along the linear path, then stop when the path splits. The low path to the right leads to extra Remnant Dust at a dead end. The scratched wood on the left side of the street is the main path.

Defeat the puppets near the shrine along the upper path and pick up the Sha-Chi Amber Shard they were guarding.

A poison powderkeg and a few transcensions block the way ahead. Try to defeat the powderkeg first, then reach the healer at the back of the narrow road. Defeating every enemy in this alley rewards you with a Blackstone Shard.

Open the golden chest at the back of the alley for the Congeal Talisman accessory. It reduces Soul’s chance of Bleeding and lowers Bleed buildup by 50%.

Turn back the way you came and look to the side of the alley to see stairs that lead up to the Narrow Alley Residence 2nd Floor Bell .

Jump down from the bell and defeat the Transcensions waiting below. Then, follow that linear path to a rope that’ll take you down into another Transcension battle. Win the fight, then open the purple chest near the rope to obtain a Sha-Chi Amber Shard.

There are four paths leading away from the large pond at the base of the rope you used to get down here. Three are optional. First, look west to see an open house up a small set of stairs. Enter to find the second Quick Hand Zhang treasure, Carved-Edge Inkstone, next to the fourth Lion Dance Memory Flower .

You can also complete the Dahuang side quest by examining the golden dog in the yard behind the house.

The path to the southwest, to the left of the house you just entered, leads to upgrade materials, Traversal Talismans, and a fight against several Transcensions.

The eastern path directly behind the zipline rope, back up the way you came, leads to x2 Apprentice Healer’s Memory, upgrade materials, a Tainted Crystal Shard, and Remnant Dust.

The way forward is the path leading northeast, to the right of the house where you found the Memory Flower and Zhang’s treasure. Follow the voice you hear in the distance.

Pick up a collectible titled An Ignored Plea along that road and ring the Pond of Fading Song Bell near the three puppets at the end of the path.

Boss Battle: Gu Wanyue, the Wailing Wraith

Step into the clearing in front of the Pond of Fading Song Bell to face Gu Wanyue, the Wailing Wraith . She has a ghostly body, which means you can’t always hit her.

Gu Wanyue, the Wailing Wraith, is a ghost, which means you can’t always hit her. She’s intangible when hazy smoke surrounds her body, making this fight a bit tricky.

This is very much a gimmick fight where you can’t fight as you normally would. Try not to use Power Surges or long combos until Gu Wanyue is guard-broken. Otherwise, she’ll be able to attack you while taking no damage.

Gu Wanyue jumps into the well in front of you after the fight, and you obtain the Fanatic’s Fragment: Fixation , a material used for Soul Tempering.

That item is just one piece of the upgrade material used to Soul Temper the Fanatic’s Broken Blade weapon you own.

Pick up the Remnant Dust, upgrade materials, and collectible titled (Fragment of a Play) Fighter’s Verse before jumping down the well.

Collect the Search Memory Flower at the bottom of the well to start a two-part memory about Gu Wanyue.

Climb the stairs and go up the ladder ahead, but watch for a puppet at the top of the ladder. It’s guarding x3 Traversal Talisman behind you.

Defeat the Transcensions and puppets in the next large cavern, then pick up the second Search Memory Flower and the Mandate Encampment Outer Gate Key at the other end of the room.

This key allows you to enter the Mandate Encampment from the gate on the east side of the Village of Lu map. Picking up the key advances the Pillars of Kunlun purple quest

Climb the nearby scratched wood to leave this room, then follow the short path until you see a collectible titled Notes on the Heart Meridian in front of the Well of Wei Sanchuan Bell . Soul comments on replacing his poisoned heart with a Transcended one before dismissing the thought.

Defeat the puppet that appears just before you reach the bell to obtain the Signed Contract collectible as well.

Boss Battle: Xie Qiudong, the Divine Healer

Walk up the stairs in front of the Well of Wei Sanchuan Bell to find Xie Qiudong, the Divine Healer . This boss is a stronger version of the healer enemies you’ve encountered in Pangzhen thus far.

Xie Qiudong, the Divine Healer, is another unique boss fight, as it forces you to fight Transcensions before you can reach the boss. Target the enemies connected to Xie Qiudong to force him down to the ground.

You can destroy the explosive barrels near the connected enemies to kill them instantly, but note that the Shadow Warden and Baishan enemies following you around can’t be defeated.

You can defeat this boss without even hitting him once, but you need to be able to put pressure on the extra enemies by constantly dealing damage, forcing Xie Qiudong to heal them. You also need to defeat the remaining enemies after the boss dies.

You’re rewarded with the Everflow medicine after winning this fight. It restores 20% HP, and when no uses remain, defeating an enemy restores one use.

Continue along the road past the boss arena. There are enemies on the rooftops and on the road, so you can defeat them all for extra Remnant Dust.

Eventually, a scene triggers, pointing out a house with a green roof. Ring the Green Serpent House Bell , then walk inside to find collectibles titled Patient Record and Notes on a “Flower.”

Speak to the Apprentice Healer behind the desk, Xie Xiaorong , to unlock medicine upgrades. Enhance your favorite medicines to improve their effectiveness noticeably. Medicines can be upgraded multiple times.

Xie Xiaorong gives you the Green Serpent Brew medicine after this conversation. It removes all status effects, increases status resistance by 75%, and gradually restores 20% HP for 15 seconds.

Go up the stairs to find the Serpent Gall: Green material for Soul Tempering, along with The Four Serpent Houses collectible. Picking up the collectible starts The Four Serpent Houses story quest.

There are a lot of optional paths to take before the next boss, and I’m about to go through all of them here. Exit the Green Serpent House and face it. To the right of the house is a ladder leading to an optional area, and to the left is another path that splits.

Climb the ladder and pick up the Estate Experiments Memory Flower at the top. Continue along this path to find weapon upgrade materials, Remnant Dust, a Blackstone Shard, and two collectibles titled Memories of Xie Yuan I and Memories of Xie Yuan II .

You can also get the Bronze Essence for the Sword and the Way side quest. It’s inside the furnace near the camp full of Shadow Wardens. Return to Myst to temper the sword once you have the essence.

Open the door near the two collectibles to unlock a shortcut that brings you behind the Green Serpent House. There’s an Estate Experiments Memory Flower on your left as you open the shortcut.

Take the path to the left (northwest) of the Green Serpent House now, where three enemies are waiting. The path splits here. Look to the left of those enemies to see a large building.

Clear out the enemies inside to find a Thunderward accessory in a gold chest on the bottom floor. It reduces Lightning damage and Paralysis buildup rate by 50%, which helps against the next boss. There’s also a Sha-Chi Amber Shard on the top floor of the building.

Exit the building through the newly opened door to find another Lion Dance Memory Flower . From there, you can walk down into the water ahead for an optional boss fight against You Loong, Leader of the Blackwater Crew .

He rewards you with the You Loong’s Deluge Phantom Edge (Artifice) , which allows you to put out fires and open hidden paths. It’s also great to have for the final boss in this chapter.

Stay on the watery path through the boss arena to find the second Banyan Tree trial that’ll earn you a Banyan’s Heart to unlock new skill tree abilities.

When ready, return to the Green Serpent House again. Take the road to the left of the house, then go north when the path splits, across a stone bridge toward the story objective marker.

Deal with the Maskwalkers and continue until the road splits yet again. The path on the left leads to the Lion Dance Hall Bell . It’s in front of a locked lion head gate.

Return to the split in the path and go in the opposite direction to cross another stone bridge. Take down two more Maskwalkers and pick up the first Bitter Kin Memory Flower on the right side of the road. This starts the Kin Against Kin side quest.

Enter the house next to the Memory Flower to find the Apology Letter collectible. The Ancestral Shrine Square Bell is just a bit further up the road.

You should upgrade and equip the Thunderward accessory here before triggering the upcoming boss fight in the clearing ahead.

Boss Battle: Chang Hong, the Thunder Spear

Enter the large clearing in front of the Ancestral Shrine Square Bell to begin the fight against Chang Hong, the Thunder Spear . This boss uses a variety of lightning attacks, which can cause paralysis.

Here are the special moves you should know about.

Chang Hong, the Thunder Spear, is another elemental boss fight. He uses lightning to paralyze you. The Thunderward helps prevent the status, but try to avoid electric attacks by dodging whenever you’re uncomfortable with parrying.

There are very few gimmicks in this fight. It’s very much a defensive test that rewards you if you learn the timing on the boss’s combos. Don’t be afraid to block a bit more as he speeds up, but dodge backward if you need more space to heal or reposition.

The boss hops back on his horse for the second phase, becoming Chang Hong, the Thunder Lancer . He now has increased mobility and a few new moves. We’ve listed his new attacks in the table below.

Chang Hong attacks alongside his horse in this phase. He’s more mobile, and his horse even attacks independently of him at times.

Chang Hong and his horse are temporarily immobile after flash attack parries or dodges, so take advantage of that momentary pause to get a few hits in.

You earn the Thunder Spear Phantom Edge (Martial) for winning this fight. It can attack with lightning, inflicting the Paralysis status on opponents.

It can perform aerial thrusts when upgraded, and Soul Tempering allows lightning to chain to more enemies.

Pick up the weapon upgrade materials around the boss arena, then enter the shrine attached to the arena to find x3 Phantom Reforge Talisman, a Refined Indigo Crystal, and more weapon upgrade materials.

Then, head northeast to find the Yu’er’s House Bell . Walk up the stairs in front of the bell and check on Yu’er’s father in the bed to trigger a scene in which the Herald tries to fool you with Yu’er’s body.

Interact with Yu’er’s father again after that scene to cure him and tell him about his daughter. You then get to see her final goodbye.

Speak to Yu’er’s father once more to hear about what happened in Pangzhen. People started falling into an endless sleep just over a week ago, but those who resisted the sleep were taken to the Heart we heard about earlier in the game.

Yu’er’s father gives you the Blessed Jade Pendant accessory after chatting, as a reward for completing the Flesh Lily side quest. It activates one of these four random effects whenever you use medicine:

Inflicts Burning on yourself and nearby enemies

Inflicts Poison on yourself and nearby enemies

Conjures a Chaos fireball that automatically attacks nearby enemies

Immediately restores all HP and 50% Sha-Chi

Leave Yu’er’s house and return to the boss arena to fight three Lion Dance Disciples. Win the fight to obtain the Letter with Messy Handwriting collectible and the Heavy Lion Hall Gate Key.

Return to the Lion Dance Hall Bell and open the lion head gate at the top of the stairs to enter the hall. Defeat the Maskwalkers in the first courtyard to earn a Blackstone Shard, then walk around the burning wood ahead to enter the next courtyard.

The final Lion Dance Memory Flower is in front of you, on the other side of the pond. This completes the Lion Dance Grandmaster side quest. Pick it up, then turn right to find stairs leading to a small dead-end area. Ignore the stairs you pass for now.

This small courtyard is full of enemies. Clear them out, then use You Loong’s Deluge to douse the fire and grab the Blazing Lion Head material for Soul Tempering. There are also x2 Skilled Healer’s Memory and weapon upgrade materials here.

Return to the stairs you passed earlier to enter a combat encounter on he upper level of the hall. Defeat the three enemies there and continue to find a shortcut ladder back to the first courtyard and a Sha-Chi Amber Shard chest at a shrine. Walk around the shrine and up the stairs to find the Lion Dance Hall Depths Bell .

You’re about to fight the final boss for this chapter, but there are still several side quests to complete in Pangzhen. I suggest pausing those quests until you beat the boss because he gives you a new exploration Phantom Edge.

Once you have his Phantom Edge, you’ll be able to explore much more of Pangzhen, allowing you to open seven new pathways around the town.

Boss Battle: Flame, the Mask-Bound Lion Dance Grandmaster

Enter the final courtyard in front of the Lion Dance Hall Depths Bell to trigger a flashback conversation between Zuo Shang and the Herald. Then, interact with the lion mask to begin the boss fight against Flame, the Mask-Bound Lion Dance Grandmaster. As his name suggests, you’ll be seeing a lot of fire in this battle.

Flame, the Mask-Bound Lion Dance Grandmaster, is another fire elemental boss fight. He starts with little fire, but adds flaming effects and fireballs to his attacks partway through this phase.

You Loong’s Deluge only douses Flame’s fire for a short time, so you need to take advantage by quickly going on the offensive. Start attacking as soon as he’s wet because he’ll be stunned.

The Lion Dance Grandmaster’s Final Dance

One dancer is lost, and Flame becomes a solo act in The Lion Dance Grandmaster’s Final Dance . His moveset changes a bit as one dancer, so here’s a list of the new special moves.

As a single dancer, Flame becomes much more mobile and aggressive in his attack style. It’s still a dance, but the boss is almost always moving toward you to close the gap now.

You can still use You Loong’s Deluge to douse Flame’s fire whenever he starts using flaming attacks in this phase. The water doesn’t stun him for long, but it still limits his moveset to non-fire attacks for a short time.

You earn the Dormant Flaming Mane for winning this fight, but you can’t use it just yet. Ring The Sealed Lion Crane Bell to see a flashback that shows the first meeting between Zuo Shang and Leng Tu, Herald of the Veil.

They speak of how Lady Inanis created the Chord using her daughter’s soul, and how Leng Tu wishes to study and replicate the methods used to create her.

After the flashback, Soul says he needs to visit his old friend Lei Dang at Jingyang Hall. Travel to the Jingyang Hall Bell and walk through the red doors in front of you.

Walk around the large courtyard to find x2 Traversal Talismans and a Tainted Crystal Shard before approaching the guards at the door ahead.

Here, you’ll meet Lei Dang, a man with a cannon for an arm. He trusts Soul and tells him that the Herald is crafting the Heart he’s looking for at the Mirage Estate .

Ask Lei Dang about Soul’s Tainted Heart and the Flaming Mane to continue. You receive the true Flaming Mane Phantom Edge (Artifice) . It unleashes a stream of fire, launches fireballs, and can burn away bramble to uncover hidden paths.

You can complete all unfinished side quests in Pangzhen now that you have the Flaming Mane. There’s a lot to do here, with plenty of rewards waiting. Here’s a list of each side quest that can be completed in Pangzhen right now, with links to their respective guide page:

Finish all of these side quests and explore the rest of Pangzhen to earn the Manor Medicine Pot accessory, the Crimson Resolve Accessory, the Dance Fan accessory, the Formless Divine Mirror accessory, Soul Tempering materials for the Dread Axe, Kuye Temple Prayer Beads, Flaming Mane, and Soft Snake Sword, the rest of Zhang’s treasures, and the Goldblaze Phantom Edge (Ranged) from Zhang. Four Fierce Axes

You’ll also find the Back Hill Pavilion Bell to the southwest, near two Mother’s Heart Memory Flowers . Collecting those flowers rewards you with the Merciful Dew medicine and completes the A Mother’s Heart side quest. North of that is the Pangzhen Slums Bell and the Old Man Gen’s House Bell .

You can also fight an optional boss, Acolyte Lei Ting , as part of the Secrets at the Heart of the Lake purple quest. Lei Ting gives you Leiting’s Thunder Mask . Use the Flaming Mane on the bramble east of the Pavilion of Knowledge Crossroads Bell to open the way to Meigu Lake.

On that path, you’ll find the Mandate Lodgings Bell and the Dockside Warehouse Bell leading northeast.

When ready, use the Flaming Mane on the bramble west of the Pavilion of Knowledge Crossroads Bell, north of where you fought Cavalrybane.

Climb the stairs, defeat the puppets, and look to the left to find the final Estate Experiments Memory Flower .

Ring the Mirage Estate Bell at the top of the stairs, then walk through the doorway and climb the next set of stairs to trigger a scene. The Herald is still controlling Yu’er’s body, but this seems to be his base of operations.

Pick up the Unsigned Poem collectible next to you after the scene to learn that there’s a passage that leads from the Green Serpent House to the Mirage Estate.

Travel to the Green Serpent House and interact with the serpent gate to the right of Xie Xiaorong to learn that you need a Serpent Tongue for the Serpent’s Maw, a Serpent Fang for its mouth, and a Serpent Eye .

The Heart’s Trail quest can’t continue until you visit the other Serpent Houses to collect those items. For now, we’ll move on to the next story quest, The Four Serpent Houses .

Up Next: Phantom Blade Zero True Ending Walkthrough and Requirements Checklist

articles.title: Don't Miss the Best Prebuilt Gaming PC Deals for Black Friday Featuring Nvidia GeForce and AMD Radeon GPUs
articles.summary: From RTX 5060 to RTX 5080, the sales are coming in, but also selling out quickly.
articles.body:
Black Friday sales have officially gone live at Amazon, Walmart, and Best Buy. Despite the fact that PC prices are trending in the wrong direction recently, there are plenty of solid Black Friday deals to be found to help alleviate the financial sting of your next PC upgrade. I've rounded up the best deals from the major retailers below and I will continue to update this list with more discounted configurations as they go live through Black Friday and Cyber Monday.

The Best Black Friday Gaming PC Deals So Far

Acer Nitro 85 AMD Ryzen 9 9900X Radeon RX 9070 XT Gaming PC (16GB/1TB)

HyperX Omen Intel Core Ultra 7 270K Plus RTX 5080 Gaming PC (16GB/1TB)

Lenovo Legion Tower 5 AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D Radeon RX 9070 XT Gaming PC (32GB/1TB)

iBUYPOWER Element 9 Pro AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D Radeon RX 9070 XT Gaming PC (32GB/2TB)

iBUYPOWER Y50 AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D RTX 5070 Ti Gaming PC (32GB/2TB)

iBUYPOWER Scale Intel Core Ultra 5 225F RTX 5060 Gaming PC (16GB/1TB)

With the price of GPUs and RAM at an all-time high, it's not a surprise that deals on Lenovo gaming PCs are extremely hard to come by. In fact, the last time I posted a deal on a Legion gaming PC was back in July . Fortunately, with Black Friday fast approaching, I'm back in the hunt for good gaming PC deals, and Lenovo has finally put up some newsworthy deals.

Lenovo Legion RTX 5070 Ti Gaming PC for $2,268

Lenovo Legion Tower 5 Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX RTX 5070 Ti Gaming PC (32GB/1TB)

Lenovo's Black Friday deal has a couple of solid deals on higher-end gaming PCs. The Lenovo Legion Tower 5 RTX 5070 Ti gaming PC is down to $2,267.99 with free delivery after 10% off coupon code " LENOVOBIGHOLIDAY ". The Lenovo Legion Tower 5 Gen 10 gaming PC is equipped with an Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX desktop processor, GeForce RTX 5070 Ti graphics card, 32GB of DDR5-5600MHz RAM, and a 1TB M.2 SSD. The RTX 5070 Ti is our best reviewed Nvidia Blackwell card and has the chops to run pretty much any game in 4K at 60fps or higher.

Lenovo Legion Tower 7 RTX 5080 Gaming PC for $3,330

Lenovo Legion Tower 7 Intel Core Ultra 7 265K RTX 5080 Gaming PC (32GB/2TB)

Looking for something even more powerful? The Legion Tower 7 RTX 5080 gaming PC is also down to $3,329.99 with free shipping after coupon code " LENOVOBIGHOLIDAY ". This particular configuration features a powerful Intel Core Ultra 7 265K processor, GeForce RTX 5080 16GB graphics card, 32GB of DDR5-5600MHz of RAM, and a 2TB PCIe Gen 4 M.2 SSD. Performance-wise, the RTX 5080 is one of the fastest cards on the market, bested only by the $2,000 RTX 5090 and the discontinued $1,600 RTX 4090. This is a phenomenal card for playing the latest, most demanding games in 4K resolution at high settings and ray tracing enabled

Acer Nitro 65 Radeon RX 9070 XT Gaming PC for $1,899

Amazon is offering a great deal on a PC that's perfectly suited to run the latest games in 4K. For Black Friday, you can pick up the Acer Nitro 85 Radeon 9070XT prebuilt gaming PC for $1,899.99 with free shipping after a $400 off instant discount. The Radeon RX 9070 XT is a powerful GPU that nearly matches the performance of the GeForce RTX 5070 Ti, which currently can't be found for under $1,500 for the GPU alone.

iBUYPOWER Radeon RX 9070 XT Gaming PC for $2,449

Get a free 24" monitor, mouse, keyboard, and headset with purchase

The iBUYPOWER Element 9 Pro is equipped with an AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D CPU, AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT 16GB GPU, 32GB of DDR5-6000MHz RAM, and a 2TB SSD. Although it has been succeeded by the newer 9000X3D series of processors, the AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D still maintains its reputation of being one of the best gaming CPUs you can get right now. The Radeon RX 9070 XT is the only 2025-released GPU that we gave a 10/10 score . This is the least expensive graphics card from either AMD or Nvidia that I would comfortably recommend for playing the latest and most demanding games in 4K at 60fps or higher. iBUYPOWER PCs include a three year warranty, which is considerably longer than the industry standard of one year.

iBUYPOWER RTX 5070 Ti Gaming PC for $2,649

Check out this powerful gaming PC that delivers on all fronts for Black Friday. The iBUYPOWER Y50 is equipped with an AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D CPU, GeForce RTX 5070 Ti 16GB GPU, 32GB of DDR5-6000MHz RAM, and a 2TB SSD, all for $2,650 with free delivery. According to IGN's Jackie Thomas , the AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D is the best gaming CPU for most people. The secret to its gaming performance is the inclusion of 3D-V-Cache technology, which is only found in the X3D CPUs. It's paired with the excellent RTX 5070 Ti GPU.

The iBUYPOWER Scale is a great option for budget gamers looking for a capable 1080p rig that can handle the latest and greatest games. It's equipped with an Intel Core Ultra 5 225F CPU, RTX 5060 GPU, 16GB of DDR5 RAM, and a 1TB SSD.

HyperX Omen RTX 5080 Gaming PC for $2,700

The unassuming design of the HyperX Omen 35L belies the fact that this is (so far) the most powerful gaming PC on the list. Currently this is the only RTX 5080 equipped gaming PC I can find for under $3,000. The system is equipped with an Intel Core Ultra 7 270K Plus CPU, GeForce RTX 5080 16GB GPU, 16GB of DDR5 RAM, and a 1TB SSD. It's hard to find a RTX 5080 prebuilt for under $3,000 right now.

CyberPowerPC RTX 5060 Ti Gaming PC for $1,280

CyberPowerPC AMD Ryzen 7 8700F RTX 5060 Ti 8GB Gaming PC (16GB/1TB)

For Black Friday, Amazon is offering the CyberPowerPC RTX 5060 Ti gaming PC for just $1,279.99 with free shipping after a 15% off instant discount. It's equipped with an AMD Ryzen 7 8700F CPU, GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 8GB GPU, 16GB of DDR5 RAM, and 1TB NVMe SSD. The RTX 5060 Ti graphics card is a great GPU for 1080p gaming. It outperforms the RTX 4060 Ti by about 20%, and the gap widens in games that support DLSS 4.5. Note that this model has 8GB of VRAM, which means that although it will play most games at 1440p quite well, it will struggle with more demanding games that use a lot of VRAM. At that point I'd suggest jumping to an RTX 5070.

ABS Cyclone Aqua RTX 5060 Gaming PC for $749

ABS Cyclone Intel Core i5-14400F RTX 5060 Gaming PC (16GB/1TB)

Shopping around for a Black Friday gaming PC deal but restricted to a budget of under $1,000? Then check out this listing that recently popped up at Walmart. For a limited time, you can pick up an ABS Cyclone Aqua gaming PC equipped with a GeForce RTX 5060 graphics card for just $749 shipped. Despite the low price tag, this PC is still more powerful than the more expensive Steam Machine and will get you a consistent 60fps in most games at 1080p.

Alienware Aurora RTX 5070 Gaming PC for $1,899

Alienware Aurora R16 Intel Core Ultra 7 265F RTX 5070 Gaming PC (16GB/1TB)

If you're looking for a solid deal on an Alienware gaming PC for Black Friday, your best bet seems to be from Amazon rather than Dell itself. For a limited time, you can pick up a brand new Alienware Aurora RTX 5070 gaming PC for $1,899.999 with free shipping. An identical configuration would cost $800 more if you purchased it directly from Dell. Amazon labels this as a Black Friday deal, but there is a good chance this deal will sell out well before November 27 (and it did).

Alienware Aurora RTX 5080 Gaming PC for $2,800

Alienware Aurora R16 Intel Core Ultra 9 285 RTX 5080 Gaming PC (32GB/1TB)

Amazon just launched the best Alienware gaming PC deal I've seen in months. For Black Friday, you can pick up a brand new Alienware Aurora RTX 5080 gaming PC for $2,799.99 with free shipping. A simillar configuration would cost $1,000 more if you purchased it directly from Dell.

articles.body:
With the price of GPUs and RAM at an all-time high, it's not a surprise that deals on Lenovo Legion gaming PCs are extremely hard to come by. Fortunately, Black Friday has a couple of good deals thanks to a 10% off sitewide coupon code " LENOVOBIGHOLIDAY " that just went live.

Lenovo Legion RTX 5070 Ti Gaming PC for $2,256.24

The Lenovo Legion Tower 5 RTX 5070 Ti gaming PC is down to $2,267.99 with free delivery after 10% off coupon code " LENOVOBIGHOLIDAY ". The Lenovo Legion Tower 5 Gen 10 gaming PC is equipped with an Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX desktop processor, GeForce RTX 5070 Ti graphics card, 32GB of DDR5-5600MHz RAM, and a 1TB M.2 SSD. The 275HX is traditionally a laptop-class CPU, and it's important to note that laptop CPUs are (permanently) soldered onto the, in this case, Intel HM870 mATX motherboard. Unlike a desktop CPU, a laptop CPU cannot be upgraded. If you do plan on swapping the CPU for something better in the future, then you'll have to stick with a gaming PC equipped with a desktop CPU. If you don't intend on swapping the CPU, then you'll get excellent desktop-level performance out of this chip.

The RTX 5070 Ti GPU offers solid 4K gaming performance without pricing gamers out

The RTX 5070 Ti is our best reviewed Blackwell card because it offers the best bang for your buck in terms of 4K gaming performance. It performs neck-and-neck with the previous generation RTX 4080 Super and pulls ahead in any game that supports multi-frame generation, especially with the DLSS 4.5 update .

It is fully capable of running any game in 4K at 60fps, including Death Stranding 2 and Crimson Desert . The RTX 5070 Ti also comes equipped with 16GB of VRAM like the RTX 5080, making it viable for AI work. Since this GPU is impossible to find as a standalone card for under $999.99, buying a prebuilt computer is the only way to avoid a markup.

articles.title: GTA 6: The AI race to clone the world's biggest video game for PC
articles.summary: With an official PC version potentially still months away, fans are getting impatient.
articles.body:
Hot off its record-breaking console launch, the developer of Grand Theft Auto 6 is facing a problem – and it's one that is increasingly affecting the wider games industry.

Rockstar is yet to announce an official PC version of GTA 6, but with the emergence of powerful AI tools, coders and gamers have taken matters into their own hands.

The developer has typically released Grand Theft Auto on PC long after its initial console launch – 19 months later in the case of GTA 5.

This time it may not have that luxury – in part because of an apparent leak of files from an Xbox development build of the game, but also due to the rapid advance of AI coding platforms.

These tools are being used to recreate or adapt existing games, sometimes within days, taking away the control developers have over their products.

Barely a week after the release of GTA 6, efforts are already under way to get an unofficial version playable on PC, although some projects have faced takedown notices from the game's publisher.

For some gamers, it's an exciting prospect, despite the legal questions surrounding the process.

For developers, it may be a warning: if a game as big as GTA 6 can be recreated, what does that mean for everyone else?

Like 'looking at a painting and making your own replica'

The recent wave of AI-assisted game recreation has been widely linked to Anthropic's Opus 5.5 model, released in September, and to agentic tools such as Claude Code.

Mark Brown, creator of the YouTube channel Game Maker's Toolkit and whose own game Word Play was recently recreated using AI, said cloning largely took two forms: replication and reverse engineering.

Replication is where someone asks an AI chatbot such as Claude or ChatGPT to build a new game based on an existing one, possibly using screenshots or a description.

This, he said, was similar to "looking at a painting and making your own replica" – something which is "a very close copy, but is ultimately a new painting".

It's a particular issue among smaller studios, many of whom worry that AI makes it easier for others to copy their work.

When indie developers Sodoj and Marco from the studio Robotonic noticed a version of their unreleased puzzle game 204Snake appear on the free games platform Yandex with the same name, they were "appalled".

"The game was essentially the exact same idea, the exact same mechanics as we had, but with the art looking a bit off," Marco told the BBC .

The duo were able to issue a copyright strike to Yandex and Google to get the copy taken down, but said it only felt like a "small victory".

The second approach – reverse engineering – involves working backwards from a finished game to understand how it was created.

One way of doing this is decompilation, which attempts to turn the game's final version into something closer to its original source code.

Brown compares the process to "taking a cake and somehow turning it back into the original recipe, with the exact quantities of flour, eggs, and milk used, so anyone can remake the same cake".

Reverse-engineering projects have helped bring games such as Halo: Combat Evolved and Grand Theft Auto: Vice City to web browsers.

A related technique, recompilation, can help adapt a game that has been reverse-engineered to run on different hardware. This is one of the methods being explored in efforts to get GTA 6 onto PC.

Coders wanting to attempt this with Rockstar's latest game face a difficult task because of its sheer size and complexity.

Earlier in November, Cyberleek – a hacker or group of hackers – released what they claimed to be a near-complete Xbox development build of the game. They later leaked what they claimed to be the missing .exe file needed to launch the game.

It gave those working on an unofficial PC version a crucial new starting point.

"Now people are using AI to try and decompile it, make a modified version that could run on PC, and compile a new version," said Brown.

Since the leak, several groups have posted claims of their progress on platforms such as X, ranging from getting the game to boot up to making it run at a stable rate.

One attempt seen by the BBC on X purported to have some of the game running nearly as smoothly as it does on console, albeit on a high-end PC.

Accounts and sites have even sprung up to track the various attempts, excitedly sharing clips of the latest milestone passed and scoring their efforts.

Rockstar and its parent company, Take-Two Interactive, have not confirmed the authenticity of the leaked build, and neither has responded to the BBC's request for a statement.

However, Take-Two has issued take down notices of public projects aiming to port the Xbox version to PC on platforms such as GitHub.

"There are no remedies available to rectify this clear attempt to facilitate copyright infringement based upon Take-Two's copyrighted property," one notice stated.

Why is there a wait for the official PC version?

News of the leak has been celebrated by some gamers on Reddit, who resent having to wait for the PC release.

"Why should the PC players have to wait half a year if you can develop the game in weeks as shown so far!" wrote one gamer .

"Will be funny when the decomp runs way better than whatever Rockstar can make," said another.

Christopher Dring, editor-in-chief and co-founder of The Game Business, said part of the reason why the games are often released on PCs months after consoles is that PC versions are "complex" with "different hardware configurations", as opposed to the more standardised set-up of consoles.

He added there could also be a more commercial reason, as Rockstar can "have a second moment when the PC version is ready".

In an interview with The Wall Street Journal , the chief executive of Take-Two Interactive, Strauss Zelnick, said while piracy was a "fact of life" in the entertainment business, it had until now been "less of an issue" for video games due to their "file sizes and complexity".

However, Zelnick also reportedly told an investor Q&A that the company was "utterly focused on enhancing our technical defences and... legal activities appropriately".

Grand Theft Auto 6 is a masterpiece, say critics

Dr Tommy Thompson, an AI consultant who presents the AI and Games YouTube channel, said the practice of decompilation exists in a "grey area" until it "reaches a point where copyright and intellectual property [IP] are infringed upon".

He added that decompiling code could be legal within limits, such as for educational purposes, but "as soon as you attempt to use it to redistribute or repackage existing software", then this is "largely illegal".

"In most cases, decompiling or recompiling code is likely to involve unauthorised use of the game IP," said Aaron Treble, a UK intellectual property lawyer for Lewis Silkin.

Anyone who releases or sells a clone "will almost certainly be infringing [on copyright]", Treble added, though he said the law on AI companies' own responsibility is still evolving.

Anthropic has reportedly since told Claude Code to steer away from recreating specific existing games , saying this would breach its usage policy.

Despite this, people are continuing to work on an unofficial PC game, hoping to make it playable before Rockstar releases the official version.

"Seeing as this has already affected industry giants with very deep pockets, the proverbial bear has been poked," said Brown.

articles.title: TSSAA football championship game pairings for 2026 BlueCross Bowl matchups
articles.summary: The TSSAA football championship games are set for the 2026 BlueCross Bowls. See who will play Dec. 3-5 in Chattanooga.
articles.body:
The TSSAA football championship games are set. The final weekend of the Tennessee high school football schedule has been determined.

The TSSAA will hold nine state championship games from Dec. 3-5 at Finley Stadium in Chattanooga. The state title games, referred as BlueCross Bowls, begin with Division II football championship games on Dec. 3, Class 1A, 3A and 5A on Dec. 4 and Class 2A, 4A and 6A on Dec. 5.

The TSSAA football playoff championship games were set Nov. 20 for the Division II championship games. That gave the private school title game participants an off week to prepare. Now, the rest of the weekend is set.

The TSSAA football championship matchups are being set after the results of semifinal games on Nov. 27.

The Division II state championship games were set on Nov. 20 and will take place on Dec. 3 in Chattanooga.

The six Division I state title games at the BlueCross Bowl are being set throughout the night on Nov. 27.

See the TSSAA football championship matchups below, updated as semifinals are completed:

Game times are listed in central standard time.

TSSAA football Division II championship game schedule: Dec. 3 games

The TSSAA football Division II championship games will be held on Thursday, Dec. 3 at Finley Stadium in Chattanooga.

Nashville Christian (10-2) vs. USJ (11-1), 2 p.m. Central

Lausanne (9-3) vs. BGA (12-1), 10 a.m. Central

Baylor (12-0) vs. Brentwood Academy (10-2), 6 p.m. Central

TSSAA football Division I championship game schedule: Dec. 4 games

The TSSAA football championships will be held on Friday, Dec. 4 and Saturday, Dec. 5 for all six Division I championship.

Coalfield-South Pittsburg winner vs. Wayne County-McKenzie winner, 2 p.m. Central

Tyner (13-1) vs. Fairview-Westview winner, 10 a.m. Central

Knoxville Central (13-1) vs. Page-Munford winner, 6 p.m. Central

Division I championship game schedule: Dec. 5 games

Cannon County-Gordonsville winner vs. East Nashville-MASE winner, 2 p.m. Central

Alcoa-White County winner vs. Pearl-Cohn-Lexington winner, 10 a.m. Central

Maryville-Riverdale winner vs. Whitehaven-Southwind winner, 6 p.m. Central
